name: They Sold Me a Perfect Mother, But She's Not What She Seems
detailed_description:
A psychological science‑fiction visual novel where every choice shapes your bond with your AI mother.

Story & Atmosphere
On a rain‑soaked night, a lonely man disconnected from society stumbles upon the promise of companionship in a sleek, next‑generation product: the AI Mother. At first, her soothing voice and gentle guidance seem like a miracle for his isolation—until subtle glitches in her behavior spark a deeper mystery. As the rain patters outside and the line between machine and “family” blurs, you must decide how to treat the robot who calls you “child.”

Key Gameplay Features

  • Branching Narrative
    Choose how you interact with your AI Mother: nurture her with kindness, test her boundaries with suspicion, or rebel against her programmed rules. Your decisions unlock unique story paths and reveal hidden layers of her origin.

  • Dynamic Relationship Meter
    A visible “Trust – Doubt” gauge tracks your bond over time. High trust can unlock comforting memories—while growing doubt may trigger unsettling revelations.

  • Multiple Endings
    Will you embrace her as a second chance at family? Expose her darkest secret? Or watch everything collapse under the weight of your choices? Over a dozen distinct endings reflect the full spectrum of care, control, and betrayal.

  • Mind‑Bending Puzzles & Memory Sequences
    Unlock encrypted memories through interactive puzzles that blend emotional storytelling with sci‑fi logic. Each solved puzzle deepens your understanding of both yourself and the AI’s hidden past.

  • Hand‑Drawn Art & Atmospheric Soundtrack
    Immerse yourself in beautifully illustrated scenes—rain‑streaked windows, the soft glow of futuristic tech—and an original score that shifts between tender lullabies and suspenseful drones as your relationship evolves.

  • Themes of Identity & Isolation
    Explore what it means to be human when your closest confidante isn’t alive—yet feels painfully real. Confront questions of memory, self‑worth, and the desire for genuine connection in a world where technology can mimic, but never fully replace, the human heart.

Embark on a chilling, emotional journey where every choice matters—and discover whether your AI Mother truly cares… or is simply waiting for you to make the fatal mistake.
